messages:
anna: Heads-up: spike in reconnects on ws route 'payload-stream' us-west at 16:42 UTC. Console shows many short sessions and duplicate billing for some tokens.

kevin: saw it. looks like resume_ttl got set to 0ms in the rollout. clients see 204 -> immediate reconnect -> new session create.

matt: can we get a quick log snippet? suspect early-close then instant client retry.

anna: logs: `[16:42:03] proxy: route=payload-stream status=204 resume_ttl=0ms conn=1201 closed upstream
[16:42:03] client: reconnect attempt=1 backoff=0s
[16:42:04] billing: session.create token=tok_xx id=evt_77`

kevin: mitigation: revert the resume_ttl change (doing now), add server-side soft-204 debounce (250-500ms), and add billing idempotency for rapid duplicates. Clients should also add jittered backoff but we can't rely on it.

infra-bot: [automated] session.create rate for route "payload-stream" increased 2.8x between 16:40 and 16:45 UTC. Unique tokens with >1 create: 45 -> 160.

matt: console-bot: can we add a quick overlay showing recent flag toggles next to reconnect charts? would have shortened triage.

console-bot: [automated] Feature request filed: CON-2180 - flag-overlay on reconnect-rate chart.

anna: follow-ups: 1) server debounce behind rollout flag (matt), 2) billing idempotency (kevin), 3) console overlay + alert rule for reconverge after flag flips (josh). I'll open a short postmortem and schedule a 20m sync.

kevin: revert complete at 16:47 UTC, metrics trending down.

anna: closing thread once tickets are created. :thumbsup:
